sections.title: Announcement returns
sections.question: How does the stock react when the board fires the CEO, and does it matter who and why?
sections.interpretation: Over trading days -1 to +1, forced exits earn -2.7% (t = -5.99, N = 524) and retirements -0.3%. Fired founders earn -5.4% against -2.5% (gap p 0.264). Financial misconduct costs -7.7%, sex or relationship scandals 1.3% (gap p 0.010). Prices fall -5.1% over days -30 to -2 and are flat over days +2 to +60 (-0.3%).

methodology.test: Cross-sectional t, Boehmer-Musumeci-Poulsen standardized t, Wilcoxon signed-rank; Welch t and Mann-Whitney U for differences
methodology.data: Daily total returns; market model estimated over trading days -250 to -30 for days -1 to +1; market-adjusted returns for longer windows
methodology.caveat: Day 0 is the first trading day on or after the announcement. Reasons other than the hand-checked conduct labels are model codes.
